title: Script Arguments
story: Scripts take input from the command line. The first word is $1, the second is $2, and $# counts them.
goal: Print: Hello NAME, you passed N argument(s) where NAME is the first argument and N is how many were passed.
starter: # $1 is the first argument, $# is how many
hints: Use $1 for the first argument and $# for the count.
Put both inside one double-quoted echo.
socratic: Which variable holds the first argument?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Script Arguments”?
